item.title: Thermal limits of direct-to-chip liquid cooling for 150 kW GPU training clusters
item.description: We model heat rejection for direct-to-chip liquid cooling in GPU training clusters at rack densities up to 150 kW and show that CDU flow rates, not chip temperature, bound usable capacity in existing data center halls.
